system@link.description: Link to the system producing the observations

outputName.description: Name of the system output feeding this datastream

procedure@link.description: Server-provided link to the procedure shared by all observations in this datastream. Omitted when no common procedure can be represented.

deployment@link.description: Server-provided link to the deployment shared by all observations in this datastream. Omitted when no common deployment can be represented.

featureOfInterest@link.description: Server-provided link to the ultimate feature of interest shared by all observations in this datastream. Omitted when no common target can be represented.

samplingFeature@link.description: Server-provided link to the sampling feature shared by all observations in this datastream. Omitted when no common target can be represented.

observedProperties.description: Server-derived descriptions of properties observed by this datastream. `null` indicates that no common property list is available.

oneOf.description: List of observed properties included in this datastream

definition.description: Identifier for the observed property, normally a resolvable URI.

label.description: Human-readable name of the observed property.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of the observed property.

phenomenonTime.description: Server-derived time extent spanning the phenomenon times of observations in this datastream. `null` indicates that no extent is available.

oneOf.description: Time extent spanning all phenomenon times of observations in this datastream

phenomenonTimeInterval.description: Expected interval between observations of feature-of-interest properties.

resultTime.description: Server-derived time extent spanning the result times of observations in this datastream. `null` indicates that no extent is available.

oneOf.description: Time extent spanning all result times of observations in this datastream

resultTimeInterval.description: Expected interval between production of observation results.

type.description: Kind of data carried by this datastream.

resultType.description: Server-derived structural category of observation results in this datastream. `null` indicates that no common category is available.

live.description: Whether live data is currently available from this datastream. A server MAY generate the effective status and MAY ignore client-supplied values or updates.

oneOf.description: The server does not expose an availability determination.

schema.description: Schema describing the content of observations in this datastream. The exact syntax of the schema depends on the encoding format.
